title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Salaam! I believe that niqab is farz. I want to wear it but since I will be the only one doing it in my close surrounding, I do not feel ready to observe niqab during family gatherings. People have been telling me that either you wear niqab all the time or you do not wear it at all. So I would like to know whether it permissible to wear niqab only while going out in the streets or other public places (where there are non muslims strangers) and uncover my face in front of non-mehram relatives (cousins and brothers in law)? I mean is it ok to do it sometimes rather than not doing it at all? 2654 views Q. I am currently a lease holding tenant for a business. i am thinking to buy this business as a free hold, however i will have to get a mortgage from 'the islamic bank of britain' they say that this 'islamic type' mortgae is allowed in shariah. they charge rent instead of intrest but they charge this rent according to the goverment intrest rate. e.g. if i put 25% of capital, 75% is the banks share. as i repay my debt my share of the property increases and the banks share decreases. The bank also shares insurance premiem & building maintanance cost according to percentage share. please tell me is this type of mortage, from 'the islamic bank of britain' is allowed in shariah. please reply to this question. 1406 views Q. Last Night in my dream.. well it was morning time actually, I had a dream that i was on the phone to my fiancee and i was reciting namaaz to him.. first i read subhanakallah humma ect.. then i read alhamdulilahhe rabbil alameen ect.. then i recited atthahiyato lilahi wasalwato ect.. then i read rabig alini mukimasalati ect.. then i said to him i am a little confused on this bit.. after that i saw myself reading full namaaz and then whilst making dua, i was saying sorry to Allah(swt) for not reading namaaz earlier. Please note... this was morning time, then i woke up. Please tell me the meaning to my dream a.s.a.p.. i have also had the same kind of dream before too. Once I saw myself reading alhamdulilahi ect.. and the next time i saw myself doing sajhda and bowing my head down to allah for respect. 1343 views Q. I want to know the meaning of my dream. "In my dream, Me and my two office colleagues go for lunch to a hotel near my office, as the hotel is known to me its very affordable and budget priced hotel, after having the lunch, I tell my colleagues that i will pay the bill, but to my surprise the bill amount comes as Rs.9000/=. I get shocked from it, but i pay the amount to the hotel person but later on feel that the amount is too high as we know the hotel is a budget hotel and i ask the hotel owner to reason out why the bill amount is so high, i also think of an option to ask my colleagues to give their share as the amount is too high. after this i dont remember" please give the meaning of this dream, 1251 views Q. I just stood there and i was just staring at it. Please let me know what this means. 1207 views Q. Please help me in this regard. Assalam-o-alaykum. 1412 views Q. Now my mother has done Istikhara for one week, last two days she had dreams, 6th Day dream: My mohter saw two girls and two boys and one of the boy is my younger brother. 7th Day dream: My mother saw some male and female members in white clothes collectively performing zikr along with my Qala. Can you please interpret this dream and guide me further in this regard. 1612 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 50244 Country: India Title: Seeing Ulema/Pious people Question: Please interpret this dream for me one night I saw Maulana Tariq Jameel in my dream I was in some place in a room which seems old and someone knocked the door when I opened the door I saw Maulana Tariq Jameel entering with salam I answered his salaam then he hugged me and held my hand told me to sit with him and someone offered him guava I saw only 1 slice of it in a plate, he made it two by breaking it with his fingers and offered me 1 we both ate it and he stood up and again held my hand and we was about to leave that time one man came and greeted him and did musafah and he said to Maulana that "whatever he is today all because of you Maulana" then Maulana said whatever you are all because of Allah. Maulana smiled at me several times seeing at my face he was very generous and kind to me. And we ate food in same plate too. It will very kind and helpful if you interpret this dream for me. I am 23 years old boy and I saw this dream around 3:00 am at night. Answer ID: 50244 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 352/305/H=03/1435) Ma-shaAllah, it is nice dream. The meaning is that you shall get spiritual blessings from tablighi jamah and its elders. You should follow sunnah in tabligh system and in each matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
